verdict.rationale: Figma does offer automation surfaces (plugins, the MCP server, REST API, webhooks), so asking about versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is fair. However, the evidence never documents any of these for plugins, agent actions, or other automations. File version history and webhooks that fire when a version is added cover design files, not automations, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
